shapeSummary: 90 mm diameter, 10 mm wide wheel with its axis along Z, centered at X=0 and Z=0, spanning Y 0 to 90. It has a black outer tire ring (R41 to R45, 10 mm wide), a thinner white rim ring, six spokes made from three crossing bars, a central hub, and a 5.8 mm through bore.
warnings: The 90 mm diameter and 10 mm width come from unverified listing data.
The tire and rim radial thicknesses, spoke width and thickness, and hub size are estimated from the image.
The 25-tooth spline profile is not modeled; the hub has a plain 5.8 mm round bore.
The six M3/#4 mounting holes (19.1 mm spacing) and the M2 screw slots are omitted because their exact positions and diameters are unclear.
The tire and rim are fused into one solid, although they are separate parts in the product.
The tire tread texture is not modeled.
cadquery:
tire = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(45).circle(41).extrude(5, both=True)
rim = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(41.5).circle(38.5).extrude(4, both=True)
hub = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(6.5).extrude(3.5, both=True)
spokes = None
for a in (0, 60, 120):
    s = (cq.Workplane('XY').box(78, 4, 4)
         .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), a))
    spokes = s if spokes is None else spokes.union(s)
body = tire.union(rim).union(spokes).union(hub)
bore = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(2.9).extrude(6, both=True)
part = body.cut(bore).translate((0, 45, 0))
